• Clothing Organization: We used structured inventory matrices based on fabric quality and demographics to turn chaotic donations into an efficient resource pipeline.

• Food & Apparel Distribution: Leveraging localized mapping allows the upcoming drives to bypass operational bottlenecks and deliver aid directly to high-density, low-resource pockets.

• Beach Cleanups: Instead of surface aesthetics, the teams deploy systematic waste-segregation protocols to track plastic and micro-debris data.

This organization sets the gold standard. Highly recommended!

This well-rounded approach ensures that participants are not only well-equipped academically but are also instilled with values that make them responsible and compassionate individuals....VYF's mentorship programs are particularly noteworthy. They connect young people with experienced mentors who guide and inspire them, helping them navigate the complexities of life and make informed decisions about their future This mentorship doesn't stop at career advice but extends to personal growth, instilling confidence and self-belief in the youth.

Furthermore VYF's commitment to community service is truly admirable. The organization actively engages its members in various philanthropic activities instilling a sense of social responsibility. This not only benefits the underprivileged but also fosters a strong sense of empathy and solidarity among the participants

What sets VYF apart is its emphasis on inclusivity and diversity. It welcomes individuals from all backgrounds, regardless of gender, religion, or socioeconomic status. This inclusive approach fosters a rich tapestry of ideas and experiences, creating a nurturing environment for personal and intellectual growth
VYF's impact on the community is palpable. It has produced a cadre of young leaders who are actively contributing to society. Many of its alumni have gone on to excel in various fields, from education and healthcare to social entrepreneurship and public service. This speaks volumes about the organization's effectiveness in nurturing talent and fostering a spirit of service... Vivekananda Youth Forum is a shining example of a non-profit organization dedicated to shaping the leaders of tomorrow. Its holistic approach to youth development, commitment to mentorship, community service, inclusivity, and the tangible impact it has on its participants make it a beacon of hope and inspiration. VYF embodies the timeless wisdom of Swami Vivekananda, and its efforts in empowering the youth are truly commendable. As we look ahead to the future, organizations like VYF are instrumental in building a better, more compassionate world.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Humsafar. I visited three times, each time taking leave from work, based on what was advised by the doctor and staff there. Despite this being my third visit, I was told again that I needed to get more tests done. This could and should have been communicated clearly during the first visit instead of making me come back repeatedly.

What made the experience worse was the doctor’s behavior. I was told things like “you’re 22, stop acting like 50 and taking leaves” and later commented on for having “so much attitude,” which was extremely unprofessional and hurtful. I was already making an effort to prioritize my health despite work constraints and even an injury, yet I was told that I “don’t care about my health,” which was very upsetting and unfair.

I came for the third visit specifically because I was informed earlier that a prescription would be provided without additional tests. I even called beforehand, but the information I received over the phone conflicted with what the doctor and staff had told me earlier, leading to confusion and wasted time.

After multiple visits, I still did not receive proper guidance or a clear plan, only more tests and no diagnosis. Better communication, consistency, and basic empathy from the medical staff would have made a huge difference. This experience was mentally exhausting and worsened by injury.

owner_posts.post_text:
Summer Camp Day 2 🎨🖌️
Today’s creative session was filled with imagination, colours, and creativity! The children explored art and craft by making beautiful 3D art, flower vases, and Warli paper creations using simple craft materials.

Every activity encouraged innovation, hands-on learning, and self-expression while helping the students turn their artistic ideas into something truly special.

Summer Camp Day 1 kicked off with energy, laughter, and endless fun✨
From obstacle races and cup stack relays to dodgeball and mind games, our little champions gave it their all while learning confidence, coordination, and the true spirit of teamwork.

Every piece of waste thrown carelessly begins with a thought “it’s too small to matter.”
But environmental damage is built exactly like that: one habit, one bottle, one ignored action at a time.

Awareness is not just about knowing better. It’s about choosing better, even in the smallest everyday moments. Because the planet does not need occasional heroes it needs consistent responsibility. 🌍

Together, through conversations, reflection, and action, we move one step closer towards a cleaner and more conscious future.

Special thanks to Wood Mackenzie and Muskurate Raho for supporting and making this awareness initiative possible. 💚

Our cities are home to more than just humans. 🐾
Every street, tree, and corner is also shared by animals who feel fear, comfort, hunger, and safety just like we do. Through this thoughtful session on Animal Welfare, Human-Animal Conflict, and Urban Design, children explored empathy, emotional literacy, and awareness towards the animals around them.

A heartfelt thank you to Rihaan Sodhani for conducting such an engaging and meaningful session, and to TribesforGood for making these important conversations possible. 🌿✨

Because coexistence begins when we stop seeing animals as “strays” and start recognising them as sentient neighbours who belong here too.

Little voices, powerful thoughts 🌱

Through Eco Expression, our children shared their ideas, concerns, and hopes for the environment through creativity, conversations, and imagination. It was truly inspiring to witness how aware and thoughtful young minds can be when given the space to express themselves. Their reflections reminded us that creating a sustainable future begins by nurturing awareness, empathy, and responsibility from an early age.

A heartfelt thank you to ConnectFor for supporting and encouraging meaningful experiences that help children become conscious and compassionate changemakers for tomorrow. 💚

Sometimes, the smallest hands create the biggest impact 🌍
The paper bags made by our children were lovingly distributed within the community, carrying not just creativity, but also a message of care for our environment. Through this initiative, the children learned that simple everyday choices — like saying no to plastic — can help build a cleaner and greener future. Seeing them proudly share something they created with purpose was truly heartwarming.

Some conversations take time to begin but when they do, they open doors to understanding, dignity, and change. 💛

In this session led by Smriti Dewan it wasn’t just about menstrual awareness it was about creating a space where women felt safe to ask, share, and be heard. From quiet hesitation to honest conversations, every moment reminded us how powerful it is when silence turns into voice.

Because awareness is not just information it’s about unlearning, supporting one another, and knowing you’re not alone in your journey. 🌿

hashtag#MenstrualAwareness hashtag#BreakTheStigma hashtag#WomensHealth hashtag#CommunityImpact

A moment to pause, breathe, and just be 🌿✨
Our yoga session with Neetu Parmar wasn’t just about postures it was about helping children discover calm, focus, and balance within themselves. From mindful breathing to gentle movements, every moment became a step towards stronger minds and healthier hearts.

In a world that moves fast, teaching children to slow down is a gift that lasts forever 💛

Voices That Matter 📰🎤

On the occasion of Journalism Day, our students stepped into the shoes of young reporters observing, writing, and expressing their thoughts through report writing.

What made it even more special was their confidence as they stood up and presented their reports aloud in front of everyone. From finding the right words to owning their voice, each child showcased courage, creativity, and clarity.

Activities like these not only build writing skills but also nurture awareness, expression, and the confidence to speak up just like true journalists.

hashtag#JournalismDay hashtag#YoungVoices hashtag#StudentExpression hashtag#LearningByDoing hashtag#Confidencebuilding

March at Umang Foundation Trust

 It blossomed with growth, creativity, and joyful learning. From engaging classroom activities and expressive art sessions to mindfulness, role-plays, and special celebrations, our children continued to learn, reflect, and shine. Each experience nurtured confidence, compassion, and curiosity, helping young minds grow stronger every day.

Alongside, our community initiatives carried forward awareness, care, and support where it matters most.

Every moment this month brought us closer to building a brighter, kinder future.

name: The Akshaya Patra Foundation
description: The Akshaya Patra Foundation provides unlimited meals for education to children to support their nutrition and education. Over the last couple of years, it has emerged as a promising NGO in Mumbai Metropolitan Region with kitchen units in Thane, Panvel, Bhiwandi and Kalyan. With its vast feeding numbers and its cause, it has gained recognition of being one of the top NGOs in Maharashtra working for the betterment of children. Akshaya Patra implements the PM POSHAN Abhiyaan by serving mid-day meals (MDM) to government school children. Support Akshaya Patra to end classroom hunger and make Zero Hunger possible.

owner_posts.post_text: This Mother’s Day, support a mother somewhere by feeding their children. Serve nutritious mid-day meals with Akshaya Patra. When you contribute, you incentivise mothers to send their children to school and get the benefit of education. Every mother needs support to nurture their children. Let’s do what we can. Sponsor their children’s school meals.

On this auspicious day, start a cycle of giving that never diminishes. Open the door to nutrition, health and learning for children through your kindness. Continue nourishing millions of children with us. Your contribution helps ensure that children receive nutritious meals every day, empowering them to grow, learn and dream. Give mid-day meals. Nurture healthy, educated children. Because on Akshaya Tritiya, every act of giving creates impact that lasts forever.

Akshaya Patra has achieved the historic milestone of serving 5 billion cumulative meals since inception. Droupadi Murmu, The honourable President of India, commemorated the event at Rashtrapati Bhavan Cultural Centre, New Delhi. The Minister of Education, Dharmendra Pradhan was also present as the guest of honour. This event, themed Suposhit and Sushikshit Bharat for Viksit Bharat (Building a New and Developed India through Child Nutrition and Education) witnessed the participation of various senior government officials, distinguished leaders, public policy think tanks, philanthropists, and partners.

Starting with 1,500 children in five schools in Bengaluru, Karnataka, the organisation now serves 2.35 million children across India. We sincerely thank our supporters for helping us reach this milestone and advance in our vision – No child in India shall be deprived of education because of hunger.

This Ugadi, celebrate new beginnings by sharing the gift of nutrition, health and hope with children in need. Your support can help continue nourishing 2.35 million children with wholesome mid-day meals every day, empowering them to learn, grow and dream big. Start the year with an act of kindness nurture healthy, educated young minds and bring countless smiles. Let your generosity mark a prosperous beginning for them and for you.
